address: 40 Stadon Road, Anstey, LE7 7AY, United Kingdom
bio: 'Sapori' means 'flavours' and that's exactly what this charmingly run Italian restaurant delivers. Located inside a substantial Victorian building in a Leicester suburb, the interior is sleek and modern, even a little glitzy, with an open kitchen pass so you can get a good look at the chefs. A passionate Italian family are in charge, drawing on influences from their native Naples, as well as well-known staples like carbonara, zucchini fritti and tiramisu. Sweet, endearing service makes a visit all the more appealing....
